set_availables: set available dataset types to control which datasets can be accessed in TFDS
get_availables: get the list of currently available dataset types sorted by name
set_availables_tmp: temporarily set dataset visibility within a context manager and restore on exit
DatasetType: define dataset type enum with TFDS_PUBLIC and COMMUNITY_PUBLIC categories
DatasetType_is_available: check if a specific dataset type is currently available for access
